messages:
alex: FYI support ticket from Acme — GitHub SSO failing at callback with "state missing". Customer sees login hang and our logs show 400 /oauth/callback missing state cookie.

maria: can you paste the ticket repro + redirect URI they registered?

alex: Repro steps from customer:
1) User clicks "Sign in with GitHub" on SPA frontend (React, Netlify).
2) Redirect to GitHub, authorizes, GitHub redirects to
   https://app.acme.com/#/oauth/callback?code=...&state=XYZ
   They registered callback in GitHub as `https://app.acme.com/oauth/callback`
3) Our server receives a GET to `/oauth/callback?code=...` but no `state` query param — browser sent fragment to client (after `#`) only.

robin: aha — looks like their frontend is using an implicit/hash-based flow or the router rewrites the path into the hash. Fragments after `#` are client-side only, never sent to server. That would explain missing `state` cookie.

mike: can they reproduce in browser devtools? ask for the Network tab -> show Location header on GitHub redirect. If Location contains `#` then the state never hits our server.

alex: customer sent a screenshot. GitHub's `Location` header contains `https://app.acme.com/#/oauth/callback?code=...&state=...` (so state is indeed in fragment). They said they used an older SPA template and didn't migrate to Authorization Code + PKCE.

ivan: quick workaround: change client to use Authorization Code + PKCE so state is in query param and server can validate. Alternatively change app to rewrite hash to query param client-side and then POST to our token endpoint, but that's messy and insecure.

maria: can we send a short reply with precise steps and a sample PKCE snippet? I can send to customer.

alex: here's a short snippet we gave them:

```
// Step: initiate auth
const codeVerifier = base64url(randomBytes(32));
const codeChallenge = await sha256Base64Url(codeVerifier);
window.location = `https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&redirect_uri=https://app.acme.com/oauth/callback&state=${encodeURIComponent(state)}&code_challenge=${codeChallenge}&code_challenge_method=S256`;

// After redirect (server receives ?code=...&state=...)
// Exchange code+code_verifier at server -> our token exchange.
```

mike: nice. Also add note: do NOT put `state` in URL fragment — fragments won't be sent to server. :warning:

robin: sent to customer with steps + links to docs. Customer confirmed switching to code+pkce fixed it on their staging. Closing? :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Ticket #3421 updated by robin — customer confirmed fix (staging), awaiting prod rollout.

maria: I'll mark as resolved after prod confirmation. Good catch everyone.
